title: GTA Online Weekly Update: 4x GTA$ and RP on Freemode
description: The GTA Online weekly update runs till November 19, 2026, with 4x GTA$ and RP on Freemode Challenges, vehicle discounts and Gun Van deals, per IGN India.
tags: gta online gun van this week

body.text: The GTA Online weekly update is live and runs till November 19, 2026, with 4x GTA$ and RP on Freemode Challenges, according to IGN India. It also brings vehicle discounts, Gun Van deals and a new prize ride to chase. If you grind Los Santos for cash, this is a week where Freemode Challenges are the fastest way to bank rewards.
GTA Online weekly update: podium and prize rides
Early details of this week's lineup surfaced on Reddit, IGN India reports. The podium vehicle is the Karin Everon, while the prize ride is the Western Powersurge.

To unlock the Powersurge, you need to finish in the top four in LS Car Meet Series races for two consecutive days. That means you will need to show up on back-to-back days and stay consistent, not just win one lucky race.
The headline bonus is 4x GTA$ and RP from Freemode Challenges. The other boosted activities are:

items: 4X GTA$ and RP on Freemode Challenges
3X GTA$ and RP on the Community Series
2X GTA$ and RP on Contact Missions and Sumo Remix

body.text: On the shopping side, IGN India says discounts of up to 30% apply to several vehicles. The list includes:
The source does not break down which vehicle gets which discount, so check the in-game listings before you spend.
The Gun Van is offering a 40% discount on the Tactical SMG this week. The Baseball Bat and the Knife are free for all players.
GTA+ members get extra perks: 80% off on Armor and 40% off on the Combat Shotgun, per the report.

Separately, IGN India notes that Rockstar Games has announced a special live music event to celebrate the launch of GTA 6. Artists named in the report include Travis Scott and Don Toliver, with more to be revealed. The source gives no further details here, so treat anything beyond that as unconfirmed until Rockstar shares more.

What to watch next: the weekly reset on November 19 will bring a fresh set of bonuses, so use the 4x window while it lasts. Keep an eye on Rockstar's channels for details of the GTA 6 live music event, including who else joins the lineup.
